critique.evidence: Strong cyber-forensic art direction, disciplined cyan/red palette, and clear hero-to-evidence hierarchy. Desktop is polished, but the hero leaves an awkward empty upper-right field and the explanatory artifact floats apart from the headline. Tablet becomes excessively tall, while mobile typography and nested panels feel cramped; the authorization/outcome card loses its useful side-by-side comparison. Across tablet/mobile, tiny tracked uppercase labels and muted body copy reduce legibility. The actual header is especially crowded: desktop navigation is extremely small, tablet relies on clipped navigation, and mobile visibly truncates “LIVE WIRE” to “LIVE WI”; contrast checks also remain incomplete for 3 tablet and 13 mobile header nodes.
critique.fix: Tighten the desktop hero composition, reduce tablet vertical padding, and simplify the mobile evidence card with fewer nested borders and more breathing room. Increase small-label and header text size/contrast, preserve complete mobile nav labels, and make the active section visually explicit across every viewport.
